zh.title: 衣索比亞航空確定訂購 10 架 Boeing 貨機　含 8 架 777-8F
zh.summary: 衣索比亞航空與 Boeing 公布 8 架 777-8F、2 架 777F 確定訂單，擴充貨運機隊。
body: Boeing 與衣索比亞航空於 2026 年 9 月 30 日宣布，航空公司已訂購 8 架 777-8 Freighter 與 2 架 777 Freighter。公告將這 10 架列為確定訂單，並非選擇權或交機紀錄。
這是衣索比亞航空繼訂購 8 架 777-9 客機後，第二筆 777X 家族訂單；該公司也成為首家訂購 777-8F 的非洲航空公司。官方公告未列出本批貨機交付日期。
依 Boeing 公布資料，衣索比亞航空現有貨運機隊包括 12 架 777F、2 架 767 貨機與 4 架 737-800SF，服務超過 70 個貨運市場。新訂單用於擴充這套貨運網路。

en.title: Ethiopian Airlines places firm order for ten Boeing freighters, including eight 777-8Fs
en.summary: The order comprises eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 Freighters for cargo fleet expansion.
body: Boeing and Ethiopian Airlines announced on September 30, 2026 a firm order for eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 Freighters. The announcement concerns aircraft purchases, rather than options or completed deliveries.
It is Ethiopian’s second 777X-family order after eight 777-9 passenger aircraft. The airline becomes the first African customer for the 777-8 Freighter. Delivery dates were not specified.

Boeing lists Ethiopian’s existing cargo fleet as 12 777 Freighters, two 767 freighters and four 737-800SF aircraft, serving more than 70 cargo markets. The purchases are intended to expand that network.

facts.claim: 2026-09-30 firm order: eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 Freighters.
